classYearUnresolved.note: Austin Hayes, Eleanor Roosevelt. RankWrestlers says class of 2028 ("RW 2026 So @113") and that is the only evidence - Flo printed no grade in any of the three Maryland brackets he wrestled. He placed 2nd at the 2024 MPSSAA championship, which a class of 2028 would have wrestled in eighth grade. Unlike Virginia, we have not read the MPSSAA rule on middle schoolers in the state tournament, so neither reading is established: the year is held rather than guessed, and his three placements stay on his profile. Closes when MPSSAA's rule is read or a printed grade turns up (22 Oct 2026).
